pending_part_2.voiceover_script: A classified Soviet military report proves we are not alone in the ocean depths. In Part 1, we explored seven Soviet divers encountering nine-foot silver humanoids in Lake Baikal... but when military doctors rushed to save them, the true nightmare emerged. With the military decompression chamber miles away, commanders jammed four divers into a tiny two-man pressure chamber at once. The improvised attempt failed, killing three men instantly. Declassified Soviet naval commander documents signed by General Nikolai Smirnov confirm that Lake Baikal wasn't an isolated incident. Similar giant underwater humanoids without breathing gear were officially tracked by the Red Navy in deep waters across the USSR, including the Black Sea and the Atlantic. Military orders were issued: monitor the entities, but never, under any circumstances, attempt to capture them again.
